title: Why Science Cannot Explain the Kundalini (1976-03-20)
description:
Confused by the chaos of modern spirituality and false gurus? Discover the true blueprint of your inner energy system and how to awaken it safely.

This foundational talk demystifies the subtle system, explaining how the chakras guide our evolution. Shri Mataji clarifies common misconceptions about Kundalini awakening, exposes the dangers of false gurus, and reveals the profound unity of all world religions within our central nervous system.

Key Topics:
• ⚡ Understanding the true location of Kundalini above the Mooladhara (Root Chakra) and why chastity is essential for spiritual awakening
• 🔬 How modern science's autonomous parasympathetic nervous system perfectly aligns with the ancient blueprint of our subtle energy centers
• 💭 Exposing the dangerous misconceptions of tantric practices and the modern myth that physical indulgence can lead to spiritual liberation
• ❤️ The integration of all true religions within the chakras, proving that all great incarnations came to sustain human evolution
• 🩺 The spiritual root of diseases like cancer, caused by disobeying our inner dharma (sustenance) and damaging the subtle energy centers

“The Kundalini is the power which is given to us, specially to be reserved for our rebirth, for our salvation, for our emancipation, for our evolution to be that what we are actually.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What is the true location of Kundalini energy in the body?
• How to recognize false spiritual teachers and false gurus?
• What is the spiritual root cause of cancer and disease?

How does knowing that all great spiritual figures are united within your own energy system change your perspective on world religions?

Archival audio recording of H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi at Sahaja Yoga Public Program 1976 in Mumbai (India).
